title: A fossil between two ashes
hook: Two dated layers can narrow a time window.

knows: Millions of years ago is a measure of age.
doesNotKnow: A fossil layer between two undisturbed dated layers has an intermediate relative age.

misconception: The fossil must have the same age as the lower ash.
objective: Bracket a fossil layer in an idealized stack.

claims.text: In the illustrative model, an undisturbed fossil layer with a fossil preserved in place between ash at 102 million years and ash at 98 million years is between those dates; real dating involves uncertainty and geological checks.
claims.source: Source lead for independent verification: US Geological Survey, National Geologic Map Database, https://www.usgs.gov/programs/national-geologic-map-database; the specific supporting text has not been checked.

claims.text: The stage is a schematic model, with stated example values or sample counts; it is not a reconstruction of an observed field site.

Recall: In a simple undisturbed stack, a fossil preserved in place lies between ashes dated 42 and 38 million years ago. Which interval brackets it? The lower ash is older and the upper ash is younger in the stipulated stack.
claims.source: Relative order or arithmetic under the explicitly stated example conditions.

recall.question: In a simple undisturbed stack, a fossil preserved in place lies between ashes dated 42 and 38 million years ago. Which interval brackets it?
recall.why: The lower ash is older and the upper ash is younger in the stipulated stack.
